stages.description: Load owner goal and validate that no fixed artifact list is present.
CEO interprets target close count and timeline constraints.
Departments propose necessary deliverables based on mission constraints.
Negotiation to resolve overlap and check safety policies.
Assign worker agents to build deliverables.
Autonomously generate priority matrix, scripts, ROI framework, checklists, and pipeline board.
QA reviews output against acceptance criteria and safety locks.
Analyze gaps between proposals and generated artifacts.
COO/QA confirm closing or explaining all identified gaps.
CEO packages all outputs and creates package index.
Evaluate performance metrics and conversion estimation.
CLO logs mission lessons to memory file.
Create widget update payloads for Paperclip dashboard.
Run verifying scripts to check artifact existence and safety.
Execute premerge simulations across master branches.
